Name: (CP) Nyapu Style Portrait for Annetta and Jelli (Cape Stardew Mod)
Author: SeaSea50
Description:
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxMrNps/mod-details-1.png[/img]

The nyapu style portrait for Annetta and Jelli is out!

There are two portrait variations for Annetta, one with a fringe and one without, you can use the generic mod configuration menu to swap between the two whenever.

You can also enable/disable either portrait to work with other portrait mods.

I used a few of assets from Nyapu's mods as a base.


Let me know if you'd like me to add anything!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JtMTbjw/installation.png<img src=[/img]

This is a Content Patcher mod so it goes in your mods folder to work. Here's a step by step process:

 [list=1]
[*]Download and unzip the Nyapu style portrait for Annetta and Jelli mod in your Mods folder

[*]You're all done! Now you can play your modded stardew save with a matching nyapu portrait for Annetta and Jelli.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/y0bTYfR/credits.png[/img]

Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/163267158][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/126170833]Lucidvisionsinc[/url] for allowing users to "customize Annetta art style" which let me release this mod! Checkout the amazing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14635]Main Mod[/url]﻿!
[/list]
I can't thank [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu/mods?gameId=1303]Nyapu[/url]﻿ enough for open asset use permissions in order to make this mod possible: Checkout out their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Portraits[/url]﻿!

Can't forget to thank ConcernedApe for making Stardew Valley :)[/center]
